storage_form: PROVISIONAL. A flat table, deliberately. Decomposing this into atomic KB entries is deferred until the librarian agent exists (M3), because the right decomposition depends on how it will be queried. See README.md in this folder.
grade_cap_reason: plan.md 10.3 rule 1: a measurement taken in another project is not a measurement taken here. Confirming any of these on the instrument promotes it to E1.
kept_fields_only: id, role, driver, automatable, read_back, lock_group, elements, exclusive_with, source, grade. Everything else in the source dossier -- part numbers, serials, firmware versions, verification dates, and the narrative of how each fact was corrected -- was dropped: no consumer reads it.

consumers.a4: axis A4 screens configurations on automatable and read_back
consumers.o1_preflight: reads back every element it is about to set; read_back false means the element cannot be verified and goes to a manual instruction sheet (2.1 rule 5)
consumers.orchestrator: one worker per channel; lock_group compiles into the locks

channels.role: microscope body: objective and filter turrets, output port, intermediate magnification, focus, transmitted lamp

coarse xy. On the body hub, so stage moves serialise with port and filter changes: one channel, one worker (4.6.8).

channels.lock_note: The channel carries two lock groups. Its optical elements belong to optical_path; the motor stage belongs to stage, because the piezo rides on it. A lock group is therefore a property of an element, not only of a channel.

channels.role: spinning-disk confocal unit: dichroic, two emission wheels, camera port, shutter

elements.note: exposure must be an integer multiple of the disk period or stripes remain (axis A1); nothing acquires while the disk is still spinning up
in or out. With the disk out the same hardware becomes a widefield path, which is a separate configuration id

channels.exclusive_reason: the driver hands a camera to one process at a time, and the tweezers GUI opens the same body. Whoever opens first locks the other out, in both directions.

widefield epi-illumination source, side-coupled on the branch

channels.note: not one device in the acquisition software: blanking and line select over DAQ, per-line power over SPI. Power is open loop but calibrated.

elements.note: abort closes this before ramping power down (2.1 interlock 1): a shutter is faster than a ramp

commanded power is calibrated against a power meter, so the command maps to a known output. It is still open loop: the device reports nothing back, so the calibration is the only link and it needs a validity window like any E2 value. Abort never relies on a commanded power -- it closes the shutter (2.1 interlock 1).
elements.grade_note: the calibration was taken in the prior project, so it migrates capped at E3 (10.3 rule 1). Re-measuring it here makes it E2.

channels.note: on the inline widefield branch only
channels.sync_note: patterns are advanced in software, not by an electrical trigger, so per-pattern timing carries OS jitter. Anything needing tight coincidence between pattern and exposure cannot use this path (4.6.8, 4.6.9).

channels.exclusive_reason: the serial port is exclusive; the vendor GUI holds it while a session is open and the connection then fails
channels.note: three axes, travel and command quantisation were measured in the prior project and need re-measuring here before use as E1

mount_consequences: a piezo position is relative to wherever the motor left it, so a recorded position needs both numbers or it cannot be reproduced
the motor must have settled before a piezo move means anything, which orders the two rather than parallelising them
the two sit on different control channels but one mechanical chain, so the lock spans channels

confirmed_meaning: confirmed_by means the fact no longer rests only on the prior project: the operator checked it here. The grade stays E3, since an operator reading is not a measurement by this system (10.3 rule 1), but the dependency on the other repository is gone and the row can survive that repository disappearing.
